name: Bardic: Quest for Love
source:
"Bardic: Quest for Love" is an enchanting blend of Adventure and Dating Sim set in the magical city of Deepharbor. Playing as either Edmond or Edna, a humble bard fresh to the city of Deepharbor, they are suddenly tasked with running a tavern. 

Players must navigate the challenges of managing a struggling establishment while exploring the realms of love, adventure, and city life in the sprawling port city of Deepharbor.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2597480/Bardic_Quest_for_Love/]Steam[/url]]
